en.headline: Observatory to assess Strong Wind Signal as Saudel may turn west
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was about 300 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong at 10am; the Observatory said it may near the Pearl River Estuary around Friday and Saturday.
body: The Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force on Wednesday morning as Tropical Storm Saudel tracked across the northeastern South China Sea. The Hong Kong Observatory said the storm was centred near 21.7 degrees north, 117.0 degrees east at 10am, about 300 kilometres east-southeast of the territory, with maximum sustained winds of about 65 kilometres per hour near its centre.

RTHK reported that the Observatory said Saudel was expected to linger over the northeastern South China Sea on Wednesday night. According to the present forecast, the storm then has a higher chance of turning westwards, skirting the coast of eastern Guangdong and edging closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary again around Friday to Saturday, 4 to 5 September. The Observatory said there are rather large uncertainties in its intensity by then, and that it will assess the need to issue a higher storm signal later this week.

Local winds were occasionally strong offshore and on high ground under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, the Observatory said. The Standby Signal No. 1 is expected to remain in force for the rest of Wednesday. Coastal waters forecasts issued at 9.45am warned of strong winds in Hong Kong adjacent waters and scattered heavy squally showers and thunderstorms.

Residents were advised to keep up with the latest signals and not to take the present distance from the centre as a reason to drop precautions, because outer rainbands and local winds can still strengthen even while the chance of a higher signal today remains limited.

zh.headline: 天文台：沙德爾周五至周六或再近珠江口 稍後評估三號波
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾上午10時位於本港東南偏東約300公里；天文台指一號戒備信號料維持至今日完結，稍後評估是否改發三號強風信號。
body: 一號戒備信號周三早上仍然生效。香港天文台表示，熱帶風暴沙德爾上午10時集結在北緯21.7度、東經117.0度附近，即本港東南偏東約300公里，中心附近最高持續風速約每小時65公里。
港台報道，天文台指按照現時預測，沙德爾今晚會在南海東北部徘徊，其後較大機會轉西移動，沿廣東東部沿岸掠過，並於周五至周六（9月4至5日）再次靠近珠江口一帶，屆時強度存在較大變數。天文台表示會在本周稍後評估是否需要改發較高熱帶氣旋警告信號。
天文台指，在沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響下，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風，預料一號戒備信號會維持至今日完結。上午9時45分沿海水域報告亦指出，本港附近水域吹強風，並有狂風驟雨及雷暴。
天文台提醒市民繼續留意最新信號，即使風暴中心距離本港仍遠，外圍雨帶及本地風力仍可加強，不懈鬆懈防風準備。
